title: SaidTech Industries
description: A Light(ish) Modpack focused on tech and cool little things.
body:
# _**Currently in the phase of remaking ENTIRE MODPACK**_
# **_Welcome to SaidTech Industries!_**

This is a light(ish) Modpack base around **3** great tech mods.
- Create
- Applied Energistics
- and Oritech

There is also a bunch of other mods to better the experience such as Biomes O' Plenty, Immersive Engineering, Artifacts, Chipped and much more. There is also a bunch of YUNG'S BETTER structures, both 'Sophisticated' Mods and Critters and Companions to add some life into your world.

Currently it is very early on in its development phase, and is planned to have quests, custom structures and more later on in the development process.
